purpose: Test-only contract profile for signed scoped internal workload and delegated principal assertions
serialization: JWS Compact RFC7515 with EdDSA RFC8037
key_distribution: Pinned per-service trusted public Ed25519 keys with explicit kid caller binding; production key lifecycle requires separate ADR
nonce_store: Atomic one-time jti+caller+recipient, TTL at least expiry+skew; deny when replay storage unavailable; later load/persistence proof
key_generation: Synthetic deterministic public non-secret test seed ONLY; production private keys never stored in repo
